digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and deprecation registry
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a single scalar knob superseded by per-class configuration (frontier/reasoner/critiques), creating ambiguity that must be removed via scheduled deprecation
The deprecation must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled(...) with permanent=False and remove_in=_MAJOR, distinguishing it from permanent renames
A bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL must map to all three class slots during the migration window, with deprecation warnings emitted at each env read site (config.py and model_classes.py)

Warnings must route through warn_deprecated and be emitted per-call at the two env read sites (config.py:469 and a new read in model_classes.py), never in resolve_model_string where provenance is lost
Operator-visible strings in CLI help, MCP tool descriptions, and module docstrings must present class configuration as the current interface, not REBAR_LLM_MODEL
Example configurations and an ADR documenting the class model and deprecation rationale must be added to docs
